text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... This is it!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Now... I can beat Brian!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: What the hell?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Tch! This again?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Hmph. It's like I'm not even on her radar.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Just what the heck is she looking a—
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: What is Brian looking at?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Тренер? Can I ask you for
something?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Please let me race against Brian one
more
time—as soon as possible.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list: Even though you just beat her?

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm not quite sure why, but I know
I have
to...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I can't help but feel it has to be as soon
as
possible...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Mayano... You felt that in today's race?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Y-yeah.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: I see. Then I guess I've gotta tell ya.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is your last chance.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Brian's decided the Arima will be her last
race
before she quits running.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Tch... It's still too early for her to quit!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Hishiama?!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: But... why? That doesn't make any sense.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
She doesn't have to... Brian was
incredible today.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: She can't stop now... I won't accept that!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Even though I won today, I still don't
feel like I've
really beaten her!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
It can't just be me. I want her to feel
excited
because of me too!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I do. More than anything else.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Some racers are so twinkly the audience
can't
even see the other racers. They get
everyone
excited.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: I wanna become a racer that can excite her like that!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Hey, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Hishiama said that Brian's last race will
be the
Arima Kinen, right?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
That means you have until the Arima
Kinen to
train me to perfection.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Thank you. Ehehe, I can't wait.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
She sets her sights on the Arima
Kinen—a race
against the incredible
opponent she so wishes to
excite. That
means we need to get her on the G1

agenda.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She has a chance this summer and
another one in
autumn. She either has to
run in a G1
long-distance race similar to
the Arima or a
medium-distance G1
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
The Takarazuka Kinen and the autumn Tenno
Sho...

text_block_list.text:
Then I'll run in those. I'll run as fast as I
can... and
get even better.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: I feel like that's what I have to do.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
